module.name: VoxBox
module.description: VoxBox branding and configuration for the administration screens. The cube, theme, login, menu, and footer ship in this module and load with FreePBX.
module.changelog: *17.0.2* Night-mode Binary Systems SI footer logo. *17.0.1* VoxBox branding module. Publisher is Binary Systems, Inc. The cube, theme, login, menu, and footer ship in this module. IncrediblePBX cannot be installed. The module carries a local signature.
